name: Ghost grants its stealth buff when Sinister Litany is cast (#2670)
contract: Ghost 705426 (Spell.dbc: effect 0 Apply Aura PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 705427, EffectSpellClassMask[4] 32; effect 1 Apply Aura ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) reads 'Sinister Litany now increases the damage of your next spell or ability within 10 sec by $805185s3% and casting it now grants you Ghost for $705427d.' data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20260921_20_reaper_talent_procs_two.sql wires spell_proc SpellId 705426 (ProcFlags 87060, SpellTypeMask 7, SpellPhaseMask 1, Chance 100) to spell_script_names 'spell_ascension_reaper_talent_proc', and AscensionReaperTalentProcs.h Rules maps talent 705426 to trigger spell {805185} (Sinister Litany), gating the native PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL. 705427 (Ghost) is SPELL_AURA_MOD_STEALTH plus SPELL_AURA_MOD_IGNORE_SHAPESHIFT, matching Ghost's own sub-tooltip 'Enter an enhanced stealth mode that does not break on damage dealt or taken.' This proves the proc/trigger chain that the issue claimed was entirely unimplemented; the +50%-next-hit flat modifier clause is not independently asserted here.
